policy: Normal fresh-save worlds. Life uses legal in-season farm crops and public farm actions; seasonal crop sale variant sells harvest goods through the public material trade action. Adventure periodically enters public forest encounters and fights by public combatTurn; Mixed alternates both. After active-character death, the runner records it and immediately chooses the first living adult NPC in state order, matching App.vue successor-list filtering and then calling public chooseSuccessor. Prosperous/Struggling change only documented initial settlement fields as controlled fixtures.
timeModel: Real simulation.simulate(), advanced in canonical one-day intervals; no parallel world model.
